source.author: verg
source.text: Illa vel intactae segetis per summa volaret gramina nec teneras cursu laesisset aristas, vel mare per medium fluctu suspensa tumenti ferret iter celeris nec tingueret aequore plantas.
source.text_original: Illa vel intactae segetis per summa volaret / gramina nec teneras cursu laesisset aristas, / vel mare per medium fluctu suspensa tumenti / ferret iter celeris nec tingueret aequore plantas.
source.text_english: She would either fly over the tops of untouched crops and not have damaged the tender ears in her course, or, suspended by the swelling wave, she would carry her way through the middle of the sea at speed and not wet her feet in the water.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: cur non simplex nec aperta confessio? totum timet, totum temperat, totum relinquit ambiguum et quasi super aristas graditur.
reuse.text_original: cur non simplex nec aperta confessio?' totum timet, totum temperat, totum relinquit ambiguum et quasi super aristas graditur.
reuse.text_english: Why not a plain and open confession? It fears everything, tempers everything, leaves everything ambiguous, and walks, as it were, upon the tops of ears of grain.
